blocks.h1: Invoice, collect and reconcile without a spreadsheet.
blocks.lead: Complex invoices issued automatically, collections by email or automatic payment, and every payment matched to its invoice. Your accounts receivable, always up to date.
blocks.intro: Collections are often the most manual part of revenue: preparing invoices at month-end, chasing payments and checking bank statements to see who paid. Relvo combines invoicing, collections and reconciliation under each contract's rules to keep your accounts receivable up to date.

blocks.h2: From manual closing to an automatic cycle.
before: Invoices prepared by hand at month-end, one per customer.
Collections tracked in a debtor spreadsheet, with emails written individually.
Bank statements checked line by line to see who paid.
after: Each invoice goes out on time, for the exact amount.
Collection emails go out automatically, and card payments are charged automatically.
Relvo suggests the invoice for each payment, with supporting evidence, and your team confirms.

steps.title: Invoice
steps.text: Relvo issues the electronic invoice in Chile or Mexico for the period's amount.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: Send collection emails or charge automatically through Toku, Fintoc or Stripe.

steps.title: Reconcile
steps.text: Relvo suggests a match for each bank transaction and updates outstanding balances when confirmed.

blocks.h2: Frequently asked questions about accounts receivable.

items.q: In which countries does Relvo issue electronic invoices?
items.a: Chile and Mexico. Relvo issues electronic invoices from the same system that calculates charges, using the legal entity and currency specified in each contract.

items.q: Can I split an invoice across several legal entities?
items.a: Yes. A single contract can be invoiced in parts to different legal entities or cost centers, with proration and the invoice description your customer requires.

items.q: Which payment methods can I use?
items.a: Payment link, card or bank transfer through Toku, Fintoc or Stripe. You can combine automatic payments for recurring plans with email collections for contracts.
Relvo sends collection emails for you, before and after the due date, and tracks each customer's payment status.
Yes. Relvo suggests the invoice for each bank transaction, and your team confirms. For partial payments, the invoice stays open with its remaining balance and collection continues.

items.q: Which currencies can I invoice and collect in?
items.a: Any currency, with automatic conversion, including Chile's inflation-indexed UF.
Relvo suggests an invoice for each bank transaction and shows the evidence. A person confirms, and Relvo learns from those confirmations to improve its suggestions.

items.q: What happens if a customer overpays?
items.a: The excess becomes customer credit, available to apply to a future document.
